1.consolidated_definition: Pareja de gallos que reúne las mutuas cualidades reglamentarias luego de ser evaluados por el funcionario oficial, quien autoriza la pelea. Sólo se escucha la variante gallos casaos. “A dos gallos bolos casaos para pelear le dicen la pelea del ocho porque los dos son rendondos y forman un ocho.” Canóvanas.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Pair of roosters that meets the mutual regulatory qualities after being evaluated by an official officer, who authorizes the fight. Only the variant "gallos casaos" is heard. A pair of roosters considered to be in their prime and suitable for fighting are referred to as a "pelea del ocho" because they are both robust and form an "ocho".
